The worker handler reads its generation from its own run row (new run-tracker getMediaIntelligenceRun). UI: DISMISSED now has a Retry action.

UC-DER-006.decision: Regeneration never overwrites or deletes a prior generation. UC-4: each generation writes its own rows (keyframes g<N>-kf-NNNN, descriptor recon-v<N>; generation 1 keeps kf-NNNN/recon-v1) and the CURRENT pointer moves only after the new descriptor is persisted: then every other COMPLETED keyframe/descriptor row of the record (earlier generations and stale variants a new generation did not produce) is marked SUPERSEDED with its object kept; an unfinished generation's rows are marked FAILED, never current; the one reader picks the highest completed recon-v<N>. Phase-31 single-variant derivatives: the canonical upsert (recordDerivedAsset) now preserves a replaced stored artifact as its own SUPERSEDED row in the same statement, so callers have nothing to delete (removeSupersededDerivedObject removed). Superseded bytes stay viewable through the byte-release gate, are counted by storage accounting and swept by destruction. The request is on custody (see DER-001).
